name: Wide Haul
description: Lifts the blade high with both hands and drops it straight down in one heavy cleaving cut

name: Lugsstrike
description: Swings the blade from the high shoulder down across the body in a diagonal chop

name: Greatsweep Strike
description: Turns the hips to carry the blade flat around at waist height in one wide sweep

name: Ready Greatedge
description: Holds the blade low and angled forward across the body so blows meet the flat and the crossguard

name: Flangelid
description: Drives the crossguard into the opponent's chest or hands to break their stance and open space

name: Flangedodge
description: Steps back off the line of attack while resetting the grip to receive the next blow

name: Stiff Counterweight
description: Pulls the blade up from the low guard in a rising cut with qi circulating along the edge

name: Hauldash
description: Slides the rear hand forward to drive the pommel into the opponent's face or ribs at close range

name: Rondelpause
description: Meets a cut with the blade held at both ends and turns it aside on the long edge

name: Lugsdodge
description: Turns on the forward foot to leave the attacker's line while keeping the blade raised

name: Pushing Heft
description: Crosses blades and presses down with both hands to pin the opponent's weapon and hold it bound

name: Open Bulk
description: Carries the blade in a long falling diagonal from one shoulder toward the opposite hip

name: Low Longgrip
description: Returns along the same diagonal with the back edge so the blade never stops between cuts

name: Square Crossbeam
description: Drives the blade up from beside the hip in a steep rising cut under the opponent's guard

name: Lugshusk
description: Lets the blade hang point-down before the body so both flanks stay covered by its length

name: Hauldrop
description: Pulls the edge back along the target after contact so the long blade slices instead of bruising

name: Easing Flange
description: Advances one long pace with the cut so the weight of the body follows the blade

name: Watching Lugs
description: Watches the opponent's hands and shoulders past the blade tip to read which cut comes next

name: Blunt Hiltwrap
description: Drops the full weight of the blade straight down with a pulse of qi at the moment of contact

name: Hard Wrench
description: Chops across the front of the body from high on one side to low on the other

name: Wrenchdash
description: Flips the grip and cuts upward with the back edge to catch an opponent stepping in

name: Firm Windmill
description: Sweeps wide with the blade and brings it back on the same arc to cut a second time

name: Resting Rondel
description: Holds the broad flat of the blade before the chest so qi can spread across it against blows

name: Heftstay
description: Catches a cut on the blade and slides it off the edge toward the ground

name: Haulamble
description: Draws the rear foot up to the front and steps again to cross ground without losing the guard

name: Bulkhit
description: Lunges forward and drives the point straight at the opponent's body with both arms extended

name: Flangehit
description: Lets the weight of the steel fall in a straight line with no flourish and no pause

name: Lugsdrop
description: Sinks the whole body with the cut so the blade lands with the wielder's weight behind it

name: Greatedge Stay
description: Rests the blade on the shoulder with the point up to cover the neck and head while moving

name: Backward Rondel
description: Swivels on the heel to face a new attacker without lifting the blade from its line

name: Kept Lugs
description: Sets the feet wide and locks the knees so a blow on the blade does not push the wielder back

name: Quick Mulinet
description: Repeats a chop from alternating shoulders so the blade's swing feeds the next cut

name: Short Bulk
description: Turns the wrists as an opponent's blade passes and cuts back along the line it just left

name: Short Overswing
description: Grips the unsharpened ricasso with one hand and cuts short and fast in a tight space

name: Heftcowl
description: Hooks the crossguard behind the opponent's weapon or arm and pulls to unbalance them

name: Ready Counterweight
description: Turns the broad side of the blade toward incoming strikes to shield the head and trunk

name: Mulinet Trot
description: Slides a pace to the side as the blade swings so the cut lands from a new angle

name: Blunt Windmill
description: Leaves the high stance with a swing that uses the opening hip turn to carry the blade

name: Sturdy Flange
description: Brings the blade back into the low stance in a swing that also cuts anything in its path

name: Level Hiltwrap
description: Wheels the blade over the head in a full arc to land with the momentum of the turn

name: Angled Crossbeam
description: Drops the point near the ground with the edge outward to cover the legs and lower body

name: Heftskitter
description: Slides between stances on a wide base without crossing the feet or raising the heels

name: Kind Heft
description: Reads the opponent's foot placement and grip to judge reach and the cut they favor

name: Leaden Overswing
description: Reverses the grip and jabs the pommel into the opponent's body at the end of a cut

name: Straight Overswing
description: Slides the forward hand up the blade for control and thrusts the point with the rear hand

name: Level Haul
description: Grips close to the guard and cuts in a short arc where the full blade would not swing

name: Folded Crossbeam
description: Spreads the hands to opposite ends of the hilt and sweeps a wide parry across the body

name: Nimble Mulinet
description: Moves the feet as the hands change position on the hilt so the guard never opens

name: Level Heft
description: Drops to one knee under a high swing and chops low at the opponent's legs

name: Single Wrench
description: Teaches the straight downward cleave from raised hands to the low end of the arc

name: Lugsdash
description: Teaches the sideways cleave that crosses the body from a high shoulder to a low hip

name: Descending Rondel
description: Teaches the upward cleave that starts at the low hip and ends above the head

name: Lugswedge
description: Teaches holding the blade across the body in front of the chest as a guard against all cuts

name: Flange Skitter
description: Teaches moving forward and back in short shuffles that keep both feet under the body

name: Flangereview
description: Teaches judging the distance to a target by the length of the blade before committing to a cut

name: Firm Longgrip
description: Lifts the blade over the head with a steady pull of qi so the arms stay loose for the cut

name: Open Lugs
description: Lets the raised blade fall by dropping the hands and the front knee together

name: Blunt Longgrip
description: Carries the blade through the target to the low guard so it can rise again at once

name: Flangepause
description: Raises the blade flat over the head to catch a falling cut and turn it to the side

name: Upward Greatedge
description: Sinks onto the front knee at the end of the cut to add depth and reach to the blow

name: Quiet Windmill
description: Pushes off the rear foot to cross a long gap in one step as the blade rises

name: Haullid
description: Holds the blade high to draw the opponent into a thrust and then cuts across their reach

name: Gnawing Greatsweep
description: Cuts from a settled wide stance so the feet stay planted through the whole swing

name: Blunt Greatsweep
description: Ends a swing already balanced so a second cut can follow without a reset

name: Solid Counterweight
description: Turns the whole body around the planted foot to sweep the blade through a full half circle

name: Planted Greatedge
description: Roots both feet and holds the blade before the body so strikes land on a steady base

name: Swaying Bulk
description: Shifts weight from one foot to the other to change the line of the blade without lifting the feet

name: Haultrot
description: Backs away in measured paces while the blade stays angled across the body

name: Rondelcount
description: Listens for the opponent's footfalls and weight changes to time the cut

name: Tripping Wrench
description: Shoves with the crossguard when the opponent's feet falter to push them off balance

name: Gnawing Flange
description: Turns the wrists so the cutting edge meets the target square and qi does not scatter

name: Hiltwrap Dash
description: Thrusts from the exact distance where the point lands and the wielder stays out of reach

name: Gnawing Heft
description: Waits for the opponent's attack to commit and chops down at the instant it peaks

name: Settled Counterweight
description: Meets an incoming blade with the strong part of the edge and turns it off line

name: Quiet Haul
description: Matches the opponent's pace forward and back to hold the gap at the blade's full length

name: Planted Longgrip
description: Sets the blade against the rising pressure of a bind and holds it with steady qi
